items.name: Neptun Deep production platform installation (Saipem 7000)
items.claim: Saipem's Saipem 7000, the third-largest semi-submersible crane vessel in the world, was used to install the Neptun Alpha production platform structures for the OMV Petrom / Romgaz Neptun Deep project in the Black Sea.
items.source_excerpt: The platform structures were installed using the Saipem 7000, the third-largest semi-submersible crane vessel in the world

notes: Saipem's own investors page (stored) carries no pipeline content beyond navigation; the OMV press release names Saipem's vessel as the contracted installer for Neptun Deep's production platform.
